title: DELETE /api/portfolio/positions/{id} — non-blocking review follow-ups
description: Non-blocking findings from pr-reviewer's review of PR #31 (api-portfolio-delete-position), tracked here per CLAUDE.md's autonomous-pipeline rule so they aren't lost once that PR merges.

checklist.step: tests/integration/test_portfolio_delete_position.py re-pastes the same db_session/client (in-memory SQLite + StaticPool + get_db override) fixture pair already duplicated verbatim in tests/integration/test_portfolio_positions.py and tests/integration/test_portfolio_get.py -- this is now the third copy. Extract into a shared fixture in a tests/integration/conftest.py so future DB-touching route tests don't paste a fourth copy.

decisions.decision: Extracted db_session and client into backend/tests/integration/conftest.py, moving both test_portfolio_positions.py and test_portfolio_delete_position.py (whose db_session/client pair was byte-for-byte identical) onto the shared fixtures unmodified. test_portfolio_get.py keeps its own local `client` fixture (renamed nothing, just no longer redefines db_session) because it additionally overrides get_data_provider with a stub DataProvider, which the other two files don't need -- forcing that into the shared fixture would either leak a market-data stub into unrelated tests or require a parametrized/conditional shared fixture that's harder to read than just keeping one small override local to the file that needs it.
decisions.rationale: Matches the checklist's own framing (extract the *duplicated* pair, not force every DB-touching test onto one universal fixture) and keeps the shared conftest.py fixture minimal and easy to reason about; test_health.py (also in tests/integration/) picks up the new `client` fixture transparently since it doesn't touch the database and was previously using the plain TestClient(app) fixture from the parent tests/conftest.py -- verified via the full integration suite still passing.

review.notes: Pure mechanical test-fixture deduplication (db_session/client extracted verbatim into tests/integration/conftest.py); no application code touched. Full backend suite: 376 passed, 99.52% line/branch coverage (gate 90%) -- no regression. Integration subset re-verified standalone: 39 passed, matching the PR's own test-plan claim. No ruff/mypy configured in backend/pyproject.toml (confirmed via grep), so no lint/type step applies beyond pytest. code-review skill (medium effort) independently reviewed the diff and found zero issues. area is backend/api but this is a pure test-infra refactor with no signal/portfolio logic touched, so verify-elder-signal doesn't apply; no new app module/dependency/layer was added (conftest.py is a standard pytest test-support file, not an architectural addition), so architecture-review doesn't apply; no API route/schema changed, so the openapi.json snapshot check doesn't apply -- confirmed via `git diff main...HEAD` touching only tests/integration/*.py, tests/integration/conftest.py (new), and docs/tasks/*.json. No UI-facing surface (backend test-only change), so the browser walkthrough was skipped, per instructions, rather than silently omitted. One incidental side effect was assessed and is not an actionable finding: tests/integration/test_health.py now resolves its `client` fixture from the new closer-scoped tests/integration/conftest.py (DB-backed) instead of the plain TestClient(app) fixture in the parent tests/conftest.py, due to ordinary pytest conftest shadowing rules. This was already anticipated and recorded in the task's own decisions entry, verified passing, and carries no behavioral risk for a route that doesn't touch the DB. No non-blocking findings were identified, so no follow-up task was filed for this PR. The task's own checklist item (extract the duplicated fixture pair) is fully addressed, and the scope decision (why test_portfolio_get.py keeps its own local client fixture) is properly recorded in decisions per CLAUDE.md's decision-memory rule -- no undecided 'decide X' checklist items exist on this task.
